description: Spec 031 development (spent seed 348, the long simulator's; never a result): 6-hour engagements with Annex B targets and an ownship turning at each 20-40 min leg, keeping the target at 3-25 km; no realism layer (steering on the true target, no sensor gaps, one contact). Laid out by the time-late runner as 2-4 periods with gaps of 30-90 min.
